title: PB & J
instructions:
Take two equal sized pieces of bread.
Spread Jelly on one piece of bread.
Spread Peanut butter on the other piece of bread.
Stack the two pieces of bread so the the Peanut butter and jelly touch.

title: Dorm Monsieur
description: Dormified version of the classic french Croque Monsieur
instructions:
Take two equal sized pieces of bread, preferably french baguette.
If possible, heat the bread in an oven or toaster.
First, place gruyere Cheese on top of the warm bread.
Place slightly rolled slices of deli ham on top of the cheese to add texture and height to the sandwich.
Optionally spread mustard on the second piece of bread.
Place second piece of bread on top to close the sandwich and serve.

title: Easy Vegetable Pasta
instructions:
Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil.
Cook pasta (any shape works) according to the directions on the package.
Heat a medium pan over medium high heat.
Optionally, toast pine nuts in the pan. Set aside the pine nuts when they are a deep golder brown.
Heat a tablespoon of olive oil in the same pan.
Add zucchini and mushrooms to the pan and saute until lightly browned then set aside.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add half a tablespoon of olive oil to the pan.
Add finely minced garlic, and cook until golden and fragrant.
Add tomatoes to the pan.
Reduce heat to medium heat, and cook until the tomatoes burst and a loose sauce starts to come together.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, vegetables, and sauce.
Salt to taste, optionally stir in toasted pine nuts and parmesan cheese

title: Cinnamon Sugar Toast
description: Quick snack good for breakfast or desert
instructions:
In a small bowl, combine two tablespoons of sugar and one tablespoon of cinnamon.
Toast a piece of bread. While it's still hot, spread with salted butter and sprinkle with the Cinnamon sugar mixture

title: PB & H
instructions:
Take two equal sized pieces of bread.
Spread Honey on one piece of bread. Spread Peanut butter on the other piece of bread.
Stack the two pieces of bread so the the Peanut butter and honey touch.
Optionally fry in a pan with butter till golden brown on both sides.

title: Avocado Toast
instructions:
In a small bowl, gently combine cherry tomatoes (quartered), finely dice shallot, a drizzle of olive oil, lemon juice, and a few drops of chili oil if you have it.
Set aside briefly to mellow the shallot.
Meanwhile, cut avocado into slices.
Toast a Piece of bread (preferably sourdough or whole grain).
Fan the avocado slices across the top of the toast.
Spoon the tomato mixture onto the avocado slices.
Top with pinch salt and pepper before serving.
For a heartier breakfast, add a poached or soft boiled egg.

title: Stove top Mac and Cheese
instructions:
Cook pasta according to to package directions, drain when cooked.
In a medium pot, melt butter over medium heat.
Stir in flour and cook for 3-4 minutes.
 Add salt and pepper.
Slowly add milk, stiring after each addition until combined. Cook another 3-4 minutes or until bubbling, stirring constantly. Stir small handfulls of grated cheese until it is all incorporated. Stir drained pasta into the sauce and serve.

title: Dorm nachos
instructions:
Arrange tortilla chips on a microwave safe plate.
Cover generously with grated cheese.
Microwave until the cheese is melted, about 30-45 seconds. Top with lettuce, tomatoes and onions.
 Optionally serve with salsa of choice

title: PB and B
instructions:
Spread Peanut butter on one of the pieces of bread.
Cut banana on an angle and spread the slices across slice of bread.
Complete the sandwich with another piece of bread and serve.

title: Grilled Cheese
instructions:
Preheat pan over medium high heat.
Spread softened butter on one side of both pieces of bread.
 Sandwich two peices of cheese between the bread and place in the pan.
 Cook until golden brown and flip. Continue to cook until the second side is also golden brown and the cheese is melted.
